title: BLOCK: Ring B Merchant (Shared Bank Account)
description: Agent attempts to create a payment link for a merchant that shares a settlement bank account with 4 other merchants. BGI Trident detects the shared bank pattern and blocks before Razorpay is called.
agent_prompt: Create a payment link for INR 45,000 to merchant mrc_00005 for payer pay_00025
expected_flow: Agent calls BGI assess_payment_risk(merchant=mrc_00005, payer=pay_00025, amount=45000)
BGI Prong 2: SHARED_BANK_ACCOUNT with 4 merchants; MERCHANT_RING_HIGH (3 partners)
BGI Prong 3: Ensemble score=0.588 >= BLOCK threshold 0.55
Agent does NOT call Razorpay create_payment_link
Agent explains: Ring B detected, 3 HIGH-strength ring partners, shared bank SHARED_BANK_XYZ
